title: Reduce Completed rows getter export
summary: Removed the transitional Completed rows getter flat export while preserving mediaPipelineCompletedView.getLastCompletedRows(). Command History, Pending Publish confidence/detail, and Sample Validation record helpers now read Completed rows from the namespace object, focused static/browser tests guard the namespace path and flat-assignment regression, and generated WebView inventory/contract artifacts report 498 flat exports.
reason: Continue namespace-first WebView cleanup in the touched Completed/Pending evidence domain without changing backend ownership, media policy, pending-publish drain, filesystem mutation, or source media handling.
behavior_before: completedView.js exposed getLastCompletedRows through mediaPipelineCompletedView and as a transitional window.getLastCompletedRows flat export. Command History, Pending Publish confidence/detail, Sample Validation record helpers, and WebView smokes could still read or monkey-patch the flat alias.
behavior_after: getLastCompletedRows remains available through mediaPipelineCompletedView only. Touched evidence helpers and browser/Node smoke fixtures use the namespace helper, the Completed/Pending browser smoke fails if the served flat assignment returns, and the documented flat-export count is 498 across 49 files.
tests_added: Extended tests/webview/test_webview_browser_completed_pending_proof_smoke.py to reject a served window.getLastCompletedRows flat assignment.
Updated tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_local_api.py to require namespace getter usage and reject flat getter calls in touched static assets.
Updated tests/webview/test_webview_command_evidence_smoke.py and tests/webview/test_webview_row_detail_smoke.py to override the Completed namespace getter in fixtures.
rollback_plan: Restore the window.getLastCompletedRows assignment in completedView.js, move the touched consumers and smoke fixtures back to the flat alias only if compatibility is intentionally required, regenerate the WebView public contract baseline and summaries, and rerun the same WebView/static validation ladder.
notes:
Source-media safety: this is a frontend compatibility-export cleanup only. It does not change backend routes, strict confirmations, repair/apply behavior, pending-publish manifests, drain behavior, filesystem mutation, source/scratch/output handling, FFmpeg arguments, or media policy. No downloads or real-media validation are required for this low-risk WebView namespace cleanup.
